h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ramgarh

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ramgarh

items.pText: Ramgarh is a cantonment town on the Chota Nagpur plateau, a short drive from Ranchi, with coalfields and industrial units across the surrounding district. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment here to schools, residential colonies and public gardens. We manufacture it at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,390 km away, and transport it by road.

Many sites in and around Ramgarh have hard, uneven ground, sometimes with rock just below the surface. That affects how the equipment is fixed and how much levelling the site needs before installation. Send us photos that show the ground clearly, along with the size of the space and the age of the children. We will suggest suitable equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, so you know what preparation the site needs.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Uneven plateau ground and how we install on it

c: A playground on sloping or rocky ground needs a level base first. On a gentle slope, the play area can be cut and filled into one flat platform, with a low edge to hold the surfacing in place. Where rock sits close to the surface, grouting posts into drilled or cast footings is usually more practical than digging deep pits.

The plateau gets a strong monsoon from June to September and cooler winters than the plains. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded parts cope with both. If you are comparing options in the region, see our pages for

facts.label: Delivery and installation

items.q: Do you deliver to Ramgarh Cantonment and nearby towns?
items.a: Yes. Equipment travels by road from our Vasai factory, and our installation team or a dealer in eastern India sets it up at your site in Ramgarh or elsewhere in the district.

items.q: What should we do to the ground before installation?
items.a: Clear and level the area shown on our layout drawing and make sure rainwater drains away from it. We tell you which footing method suits your site once we have seen your photos.

items.q: Do you also supply outdoor gym equipment in Ramgarh?
items.a: Yes. Our Fun Fitness range includes walkers, twisters and other machines for adults. See our outdoor gym page for Ramgarh, or ask us to add a fitness corner to the same layout.
